metadata.description: UAE/GCC Harmonized System tariff codes with standard duty rates

tariff_items.description_en: Smartphones and other cellular network telephones
tariff_items.description_ar: الهواتف الذكية وهواتف الشبكات الخلوية الأخرى
tariff_items.additional_notes: Certificate of Conformity required from ESMA

tariff_items.description_en: Portable automatic data processing machines, weighing not more than 10 kg (laptops, tablets)
tariff_items.description_ar: آلات معالجة البيانات المحمولة، لا يتجاوز وزنها 10 كجم
tariff_items.additional_notes: TDRA approval required for wireless devices

tariff_items.description_en: LED televisions and monitors
Static converters (UPS, battery chargers, power adapters)
tariff_items.description_ar: محولات ثابتة (UPS، شواحن البطاريات، محولات الطاقة)

tariff_items.description_en: Digital cameras and video camera recorders
Men's or boys' trousers and shorts, of cotton
tariff_items.description_ar: بنطلونات وشورتات رجالية أو للأولاد، من قطن

tariff_items.description_en: T-shirts, singlets and other vests, of cotton, knitted or crocheted
tariff_items.description_ar: قمصان تي شيرت وقمصان داخلية من قطن محبوك

tariff_items.description_en: Women's or girls' trousers and shorts, of cotton
tariff_items.description_ar: بنطلونات وشورتات نسائية أو للبنات، من قطن

tariff_items.description_en: Toilet linen and kitchen linen, of terry towelling or similar terry fabrics, of cotton
Weft pile fabrics of synthetic fibres (carpets, rugs)
tariff_items.description_ar: أقمشة وبرية من ألياف تركيبية (سجاد، بسط)
tariff_items.additional_notes: Fire safety standards apply for commercial use

tariff_items.description_en: Articles of jewellery of precious metal other than silver
tariff_items.description_ar: مصنوعات من معادن ثمينة غير الفضة

tariff_items.description_en: Non-industrial diamonds, unworked or simply sawn, cleaved or bruted
tariff_items.description_ar: ماسات غير صناعية، غير مشغولة أو مقطوعة ببساطة
tariff_items.additional_notes: Kimberley Process certificate required, registration with DMCC

tariff_items.description_en: Rubies, sapphires and emeralds, worked
tariff_items.description_ar: ياقوت أحمر وياقوت أزرق وزمرد، مشغول

tariff_items.description_en: Articles of goldsmiths' or silversmiths' wares of silver
tariff_items.additional_notes: Hallmarking required for items over certain weight

tariff_items.description_en: Gold in semi-manufactured forms
tariff_items.additional_notes: Investment gold - Zero-rated for VAT, requires Central Bank documentation

tariff_items.description_en: Coffee, roasted, not decaffeinated
tariff_items.additional_notes: Food safety certificate required, zero-rated VAT for basic foodstuffs

tariff_items.description_en: Black tea (fermented) in immediate packings of a content not exceeding 3 kg
tariff_items.description_ar: شاي أسود في عبوات لا تتجاوز 3 كجم

tariff_items.description_en: Fruits of the genus Capsicum, dried, crushed or ground (chili powder, paprika)
Cardamom, neither crushed nor ground
Semi-milled or wholly milled rice (Basmati, white rice)
tariff_items.description_ar: أرز نصف مطحون أو مطحون كلياً (بسمتي، أرز أبيض)

tariff_items.description_en: Sugar confectionery not containing cocoa (candies, sweets)
tariff_items.description_ar: حلويات سكرية لا تحتوي على كاكاو

tariff_items.description_en: Sauces and preparations (ketchup, mayonnaise, salad dressings)
tariff_items.additional_notes: Halal certification preferred, ingredient list in Arabic

tariff_items.description_en: Centrifugal pumps for liquids
tariff_items.additional_notes: ESMA compliance certificate required for industrial equipment

tariff_items.description_en: Compressors of a kind used in refrigerating equipment
tariff_items.description_ar: ضواغط من النوع المستخدم في معدات التبريد

tariff_items.description_en: Heat exchange units (industrial cooling systems)
Elevators and conveyors, continuous action, for goods or materials
tariff_items.description_ar: مصاعد وناقلات مستمرة للبضائع أو المواد
tariff_items.additional_notes: Safety certification from recognized body required

tariff_items.description_en: Machines and mechanical appliances having individual functions, not elsewhere specified
tariff_items.description_ar: آلات وأجهزة ميكانيكية ذات وظائف فردية، غير مذكورة في مكان آخر

tariff_items.description_en: Electric motors of an output exceeding 75 kW
tariff_items.description_ar: محركات كهربائية تزيد قدرتها عن 75 كيلوواط

tariff_items.description_en: Other parts and accessories of motor vehicle bodies (doors, bumpers, fenders)
tariff_items.description_ar: أجزاء أخرى من هياكل المركبات (أبواب، مصدات)

tariff_items.description_en: Brakes and servo-brakes and parts thereof
Gear boxes and parts thereof
Other parts and accessories of motor vehicles
Electric generators (alternators) for vehicles
New pneumatic tyres, of rubber, for passenger cars
tariff_items.description_ar: إطارات هوائية جديدة من مطاط للسيارات الركاب

tariff_items.description_en: Beauty or make-up preparations (other than lip and eye preparations)
tariff_items.description_ar: مستحضرات تجميل أو مكياج (غير مستحضرات الشفاه والعيون)

tariff_items.description_en: Shampoos
Personal deodorants and antiperspirants
Perfumes and toilet waters
tariff_items.additional_notes: MOH registration, alcohol content declaration required

tariff_items.description_en: Organic surface-active products for skin washing (body wash, liquid soap)
tariff_items.description_ar: منتجات تنظيف البشرة (غسول الجسم، صابون سائل)

tariff_items.description_en: Other wooden furniture (tables, chairs, cabinets)
tariff_items.additional_notes: Certificate of wood origin required, no endangered species

tariff_items.description_en: Mattresses of cellular rubber or plastics
tariff_items.description_ar: مراتب من مطاط أو لدائن خلوية

tariff_items.description_en: Other metal furniture (office furniture, shelving)
Electric table, desk, bedside or floor-standing lamps
tariff_items.description_ar: مصابيح كهربائية للطاولة أو السرير أو الأرض

tariff_items.description_en: Other seats (office chairs, dining chairs)
tariff_items.additional_notes: Ergonomic certification for office furniture recommended

tariff_items.description_en: Hand trucks and other vehicles not mechanically propelled (trolleys, carts)
tariff_items.description_ar: عربات يدوية ومركبات أخرى غير مزودة بمحرك

tariff_items.description_en: Taps, cocks, valves for pipes, tanks (plumbing fixtures)
Shawls, scarves, mufflers of silk or silk waste
Kidney beans, including white pea beans, dried shelled
tariff_items.description_ar: فاصوليا، بما في ذلك الفاصوليا البيضاء، مجففة مقشرة

tariff_items.description_en: Other cane or beet sugar
Lithium-ion batteries (for phones, laptops, EVs)
tariff_items.additional_notes: UN38.3 certification required, IATA dangerous goods compliance for air shipment

tariff_items.description_en: Motor vehicle lubricating oils and greases
Other articles of iron or steel (fasteners, brackets, fittings)
tariff_items.description_ar: مصنوعات أخرى من حديد أو صلب

tariff_items.description_en: Other articles of plastics (plastic containers, fittings)
tariff_items.additional_notes: Food-grade certification if for food contact
